hypothesis: Missing initial HMM links can reflect exact-kmer sensitivity, the minimum shared-hit threshold, the extension-ranked final cap, the pre-extension shortlist, or HMM significance. Separate interventions can localize recoverable links before expensive full-pipeline trials.
query_scope: All 1944 retained reference-family genes in their native FASTA order, against complete target proteomes. Query selection is reference-conditioned; this is a diagnostic, not an unbiased accuracy benchmark.
significance_scope: Reuse saved unfiltered E-values at the two prespecified thresholds; do not rescore or claim calibrated orthology significance from this comparison.
invariants: Use a clean immutable source revision and fingerprint Python, dependencies, C extensions, scorer files, FASTAs, reference-pair trace, and plan before and after each arm.
Require the C/OpenMP prefilter and CPU HMM scorer; never substitute the differently ranked Numba prefilter silently. Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to empty before importing the engine.
Do not force reference pairs into candidate selection. Labels only select diagnostic queries and classify observed watched pairs; candidate scoring remains label-free.
Save every scored candidate, normalized score, and E-value, not only accepted reference pairs. Preserve full target database length for E-values.

Require exact candidate and numerical agreement between implicit production settings and the explicit control settings on a CPU fixture. Compare fresh control with independently validated historical CPU observations separately; do not assume historical execution equivalence.
Default search, membership, graph, and reconciliation settings remain unchanged. No automatic default promotion.

diagnostic_endpoints: gained and lost watched links versus control
evaluation.classification: A link gained by a single prefilter intervention with unchanged HMM significance supports that intervention as a sufficient recovery mechanism, not a unique historical causal attribution. A link scored but nonsignificant localizes the observed failure downstream of candidate selection. Remaining absent links are unresolved, not automatically HMM failures.
evaluation.selection: Rank development hypotheses by recovered historically absent accepted links, control-link losses, candidate burden, and scope. Do not estimate precision from unlabelled pairs or treat diagnostic recall as orthogroup F1. Prespecify a subsequent small full-pipeline round for at most two promising interventions, including interactions only after separate effects are known.
evaluation.full_pipeline_followup: Reevaluate all eight existing endpoints on complete dataset inputs with fixed candidate/phylogenetic controls and native scoring. Use metric-vector/Pareto reporting and the existing 0.005 point-estimate development screen. Preserve all failures, missing endpoints, and sampling limitations.
evaluation.generalization: Development-exposed data only; no independent confirmation or universal accuracy claims.

resources.timing_scope: Fresh query-restricted search diagnostic on a shared host, not fresh full-pipeline timing or isolated comparative efficiency.
resources.unrelated_jobs: Do not stop, suspend, or modify unrelated work. No DGX or quiet-window prerequisite.

execution: Retain round-one jobs and outputs. Prepare and test this distinct diagnostic while they run; use sequential Slurm arms and new output namespaces. Inspect existing handles before retries and retain failed attempts.
git: Commit and push this plan before evaluating its arms, then tested implementation and validated evidence milestones. Stage only task-owned files.
